name: Chicken Taquitos with Guacamole

ingredients.name: white onion
ingredients.prep: diced, rinsed under water, and drained

ingredients.name: fresh lime juice, from 1 to 2 limes

instructions.primary_message: Dice and rinse the white onion under water, then drain it. Stem, seed, and mince the jalapeño. Mince the garlic clove. Remove the stems from the fresh cilantro, then roughly chop it. Cut the white onion into 1/2-inch thick slices. Peel the garlic clove. Drain the tomatoes. Stem, seed, and dice the jalapeño. Shred the cooked chicken. Thinly slice the romaine lettuce. Trim the ends of the radishes, then thinly slice them.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ small white onion
½ jalapeño
1 medium garlic clove
1 small handful fresh cilantro
½ small white onion
1 medium garlic clove
1 (425 g) can tomatoes
1 jalapeño
0.68 kg cooked chicken
½ head romaine lettuce
8 small radishes

instructions.primary_message: For the guacamole: Combine the avocados, white onion, jalapeño, garlic, cilantro, and lime juice in a large bowl. Use a spoon, and stir until everything is creamy, but there are still some chunks of the avocado. Season with salt to taste. Set aside.

For the Taquitos: Heat one tablespoon oil in a Dutch oven over medium high-heat until shimmering. Add onion and garlic clove and cook, stirring often, until the onion and garlic are beginning to brown, about 7 minutes. Turn off the heat and remove, leaving as much of the oil as possible behind. Transfer to a blender along with the tomatoes, jalapeños, and salt. Blend until mixed, but still with some texture.

Add another tablespoon oil to Dutch oven and heat until shimmering. Add contents of blender. Stir well, and cook until the sauce has reduced into a thick sauce-like consistency, 2 to 3 minutes. Remove from heat, add the shredded chicken, and stir well. Taste and add more salt if needed.

Heat 1/4 cup oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering. Add one tortilla and let it bubble in the oil until soft, two to three seconds. Flip and give it another couple seconds, and then remove and drain on paper towels. Repeat process with remaining tortillas.

Working one tortilla at a time, spoon 2 tablespoons chicken mixture down center, then roll up like a cigar. Secure each rolled tortilla with a toothpick. Make sure the toothpick runs parallel to the tortilla. Repeat with remaining tortillas.

Heat remaining oil in skillet over medium high heat until shimmering. Add as many of the rolled up tortillas as fit in one layer. Cook, flipping occasionally, until each is browned on top and bottom, three to five minutes. When done, drain on paper towel-lined plate and season immediately with salt. Repeat with remaining tortillas.
Divide the taquitos between four plates. Top each with a lettuce, radishes, and a drizzle of crema. Add a quarter of the guacamole to each plate. Serve.

description: Call them taquitos, flautas, or simply fried tacos, we love the soft and spicy filling housed in a crisp but still pliant tortilla shell, with fresh ingredients on top balance everything out.
notes: Optional substitutions: Mexican crema cream → sour cream
author: Nick Kindelsperger
